name: Wakai Tsubomi ~Sensei...Watashi Mou Sensei ga Inai to...~
original_name: 若いつぼみ～先生…私もう先生がいないと…～
source:
Ken'ichi Ono, a newly hired teacher at the school,
ends up having sex one afternoon with a student, Yukari Saitou.

Yukari, who has issues at home, becomes intensely attached to Ken'ichi after their first sexual encounter.
She stops resisting him entirely, no matter what he does.
And so, Ken'ichi’s training of Yukari begins.

Some time later, another student, Misa Yoshida, catches Ken'ichi in the act of “training” Yukari.
Misa tries to blackmail Ken'ichi, but he turns the tables and decides to train her too…

[Translated from [url=http://cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/tsubomi/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
学校新聘的老师小野健一（Ken'ichi Ono），
最终有一天下午与一名学生斋藤由香里发生了性关系。

家里有问题的由香里在第一次性接触后对健一产生了强烈的依恋。
无论他做什么，她都不再抗拒他。
就这样，健一对由香里的训练开始了。

一段时间后，另一名学生吉田美沙发现健一正在“训练”由香里。
美沙试图勒索健一，但健一扭转了局势，决定也训练她……

[译自[url=http://cyc-soft.com/cycnonos_pro/tsubomi/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
